tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): wire PipelineStore into Executor via NewMailHandler

Executor.Store was never set outside tests -- NewMailHandler built the
Executor with no store, so every save() call was a silent no-op and
main.go's startup stale-pipeline sweep always found an empty directory.
Thread the same *PipelineStore instance main.go already builds for that
sweep through NewMailHandler into the Executor, so pipeline state
actually reaches disk.

Part of beadle-aw4.
EOF
)"
